messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "more likely after long-term use"
set: ["more likely after long-term use", "long-term use", "higher risk of fractures more likely after menopause", "withdrawal symptoms when stopped suddenly after long-term use", "more likely at higher doses", "more likely on longer courses", "more likely in severe cirrhosis", "weight changes over long-term use", "more likely at 0.8 mg dose", "more likely in people with depression", "more likely with rapid fluid loss", "long-term use of blood pressure medication", "more likely in people with mental illness", "more likely in people with bipolar disorder", "long-term use returns blood volume to normal", "not studied for long-term use in anxiety"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
